angel-bust-with-musical-instrument.description: Half-length angel turned to the right, in a mauve-pink mantle with gold highlights over a green gown, a pale green veil over the hair and a dark blue, gold-flecked wing behind. The left hand cradles a small rounded gold instrument bound with an orange strap, raised towards the mouth; the right hand is lifted beside it with the fingers at the mouth. The figure ends at the painted hem of the mantle, as much as was visible in the miniature. The background is transparent.
angel-bust-with-musical-instrument.quality: Partly hidden in the source, so the figure stops at the mantle hem with nothing below it.
angel-bust-with-musical-instrument.title: Angel bust with a small gold instrument
usage_notes: Only the upper body was visible in the miniature; place it behind another element or at a lower edge so the missing lower half is not noticed.

angel-bust-with-trumpets-behind.description: Half-length angel in a green gown with a white collar, blond hair, the head turned slightly to the left and both hands joined in prayer at the chest; pinkish, gold-streaked wings rise behind the shoulders. Two red and gold trumpets stand up behind the figure, one long and leaning to the upper left, the other a short bell at the upper right; neither is held by this figure's hands. The lower body is cut flat across the chest where it was hidden in the source. The background is transparent.
angel-bust-with-trumpets-behind.quality: Cut flat across the chest where the figure was hidden in the source.
angel-bust-with-trumpets-behind.title: Angel bust with trumpets behind
usage_notes: Only the upper body survives from the miniature; place it behind another element or at a lower edge so the flat cut is hidden.

floral-page-margin-285r.description: Page margin surrounding a transparent text area on all four sides. The wide right column grows from blue and orange acanthus, with a green stem of strawberry plants bearing red fruit and pink flowers; the bottom strip has a grey-blue urn of orange flowers at the centre between blue and pink acanthus; the top and left sides are thin gold ivy sprigs with blue and red buds, broken into short pieces where the text and miniature stood. Gold ivy leaves on fine black stems fill the ground throughout. Transparent inside and outside the border.

provenance.object_title: Two angels serenading St. Adrian, bounded by lute- and vielle-playing angels

floral-page-margin-285r.quality: The fine gold ivy and tendrils sit at low alpha with a faint parchment fringe.
floral-page-margin-285r.title: Four-sided floral page margin, fol. 285r
usage_notes: The top and left sides are fragmentary sprigs, so the frame reads best with content set in the open interior and the right column and bottom strip kept whole.
The three figures of fol. 285r stood inside this margin in the source.

floral-page-margin-291v.description: Page margin surrounding a transparent text area on all four sides. The wide left column has blue and orange acanthus at the top and bottom, with a green stem of red and pink flowers and blue flowers with yellow centres growing from a grey-blue urn at mid-height; the bottom strip has blue and orange acanthus at both ends with pink flowers between; the top and right sides are thin gold ivy sprigs with blue and red buds, the right side broken into two pieces. Gold ivy leaves on fine black stems fill the ground throughout. Transparent inside and outside the border.
floral-page-margin-291v.quality: The fine gold ivy and tendrils sit at low alpha with a faint parchment fringe.
floral-page-margin-291v.title: Four-sided floral page margin, fol. 291v
usage_notes: The top and right sides are fragmentary sprigs, so the frame reads best with content set in the open interior and the left column and bottom strip kept whole.
Saint Margaret and the two angel busts of fol. 291v stood inside this margin in the source.

green-robed-angel-with-lute.description: Full-length angel standing turned to the right, in a long green gown with gold-lined cuffs and hem and a white collar, blond hair, and tall wings of blue, red and pink rising behind the head. Both hands hold a gold lute across the body, its rounded back towards the viewer and the neck pointing right, the right hand plucking the strings. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Two angels serenading St. Adrian, bounded by lute- and vielle-playing angels

green-robed-angel-with-lute.title: Green-robed angel playing a lute
usage_notes: Pairs with right-blue-robed-angel-with-lute, which faces left at the same scale; in the source they flank Saint Adrian.

left-and-lower-floral-margin.description: L-shaped page margin running down the left side and along the bottom. The left column holds blue and orange acanthus at the top and bottom with a green stem of pink carnation-like flowers, a blue flower, red and pink strawberries and green leaves between them; the bottom strip has blue and pink acanthus at both ends with an orange flower and a pink thistle between. Gold ivy leaves and tendrils on fine black stems fill the ground. Transparent, with the open interior above and to the right.
left-and-lower-floral-margin.quality: The fine gold ivy and tendrils sit at low alpha with a faint parchment fringe.
left-and-lower-floral-margin.title: Left and lower floral page margin, fol. 276v
usage_notes: Use as a bottom-left corner piece with content set in the open area above and to the right of it.
The Salvator Mundi and the two blue-robed angels of fol. 276v stood inside this margin in the source.

left-blue-robed-angel-musician.description: Full-length angel turned to the right, kneeling or floating with the robe gathered below, in a long blue gown with gold-dotted collar, cuffs and hem over a white undercollar, blond hair, and one tall wing of red, blue and gold rising high to the left. Both hands hold a straight cream and gold pipe to the mouth, pointing down to the right. The background is transparent.
left-blue-robed-angel-musician.title: Blue-robed angel playing a pipe
usage_notes: Pairs with right-blue-robed-angel-with-harp, which faces left at the same scale; in the source they flank the Salvator Mundi.

right-blue-robed-angel-with-harp.description: Full-length angel turned to the left, in a long blue gown with gold-dotted collar and hem over a white undercollar, blond hair, and two tall narrow wings of grey-green, blue, red and gold rising high above the head. A gold harp with a curved neck stands in front of the figure and is plucked with both hands. The robe gathers below as if kneeling or floating. The background is transparent.
right-blue-robed-angel-with-harp.title: Blue-robed angel playing a harp
usage_notes: Pairs with left-blue-robed-angel-musician, which faces right at the same scale; in the source they flank the Salvator Mundi.

right-blue-robed-angel-with-vielle.description: Full-length angel standing with the head bowed to the left, in a long teal-blue gown with gold highlights, cuffs and hem and a white collar, blond hair, and wings of red, green and blue spread above the shoulders. The left hand holds a flat gold vielle (a medieval fiddle) with a round sound hole against the chest, its neck pointing up to the right, while the right hand draws a long bow across the strings. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Two angels serenading St. Adrian, bounded by lute- and vielle-playing angels

right-blue-robed-angel-with-vielle.title: Blue-robed angel bowing a vielle
usage_notes: Pairs with green-robed-angel-with-stringed-instrument, which faces right at the same scale; in the source they flank Saint Adrian.
The instrument is a bowed vielle, not a lute; the lute is played by the green-robed companion.

saint-adrian-with-lion-sword-and-anvil.description: A standing man facing the viewer in a blue knee-length tunic trimmed with brown fur, green hose and black shoes, under a long mantle lined with white ermine and faced in pink with gold, fastened by a red jewelled brooch; he wears a white hat with a gold brim and a red jewel. The right hand raises a grey sword, the left holds a grey anvil on a block at shoulder height. A brown lion lies at his feet facing left. The background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Two angels serenading St. Adrian, bounded by lute- and vielle-playing angels

saint-adrian-with-lion-sword-and-anvil.title: Saint Adrian with sword, anvil and lion
usage_notes: The lion is part of the cut-out and carries the figure's feet; keep them together.
In the source the lute- and vielle-playing angels of fol. 285r stand on either side of this figure.

saint-margaret-emerging-from-winged-drag.description: A haloed woman with long blond hair, in a blue mantle over a gold brocade gown, rises from the back of a pale yellow-green dragon and holds a gold cross-staff in her right hand. The dragon faces left with open jaws clutching the hem of her blue mantle, ribbed green wings, clawed feet and a curling tail at the right. Below, a low grey crenellated wall runs in from both sides over green grass with small white and red flowers. The wall is cut straight along the bottom and both outer edges; the background is transparent.
saint-margaret-emerging-from-winged-drag.quality: The foreground wall is cut straight at the bottom and at both sides.
saint-margaret-emerging-from-winged-drag.title: Saint Margaret rising from the dragon
usage_notes: The crenellated wall is the painted foreground of the miniature and is cut flat; set it on a baseline, or crop above the wall tops to keep only the saint and the dragon.

salvator-mundi-with-book-and-gold-orb.description: Christ standing facing the viewer in a long brown robe with gold hatching and a gold hem, long brown hair and beard, and a gold rayed halo behind the head. The right hand is raised in blessing; the left holds an open book with red lettering. The bare feet rest on a gold orb banded in green at the bottom. The background is transparent.
salvator-mundi-with-book-and-gold-orb.title: Salvator Mundi with book and orb
usage_notes: In the source the two blue-robed angels of fol. 276v play on either side of this figure.
